summary.result: And harding shrinkage and impact resistance tended to be improved as the steel fiber content and aspect ration were increased.
summary.background: The objective of this study were to investigate the properties and to improve the disadvantages of the polymer concrete such as brittle fracture, large hardening shrinkage .
